messages:
maria: incident-bot triggered: p99 latency spike observed on model redwood-int8-v2 in us-west-2 — streaming stalls and tail latency degradation. p95 went from ~1.2s to ~1.7s, p99 from ~2.4s to ~7.1s. Detected at 2026-03-14T03:15:00Z. Paging oncall.

ops_bot: :rotating_light: Pager alert -> #incidents: eng_oncall, oncall2, tasha_sre 

eng_oncall: i'm on it, taking ownership. initial hypothesis: recent quant calibration change merged ~02:47 could be suspicious. grabbing logs and traces.

maria: customer impact: CS flagged two enterprise customers with streaming aborts/timeouts. Jamie_CS looped in.

jamie_cs: Acme Retail reported aborted streams and timeouts after ~03:14. Their app saw client-side aborts at ~10s. They are on dedicated us-west-2. I told them we're investigating.

tasha_sre: attaching quick perf snapshot: p99 spike aligns with a bump in queued requests and chunk-gap durations. Looks like streaming stalls (gaps between stream chunks ~3-6s). Could be entering a slow dequant path when KV hits occur.

sam_dev: note: PR #2784 updated quant-profile thresholds and int8 fallback heuristics; merged 2026-03-14T02:47 by @sam_dev. Also added more aggressive calib smoothing.

eng_oncall: running live queries and logs:
```
kubectl logs -n inference svc-redwood-int8-v2 -c runtime --since=5m | grep -i stall | tail -n 40
[03:14:12Z] WARN streaming: chunk_gap=3.8s req_id=...
[03:14:13Z] WARN dequant: fallback_path=software req_id=...
[03:14:15Z] ERROR kvcache: miss seq=2048 req_id=...
```

ops_bot: autoscaler activity: added 2 pods at 03:16 due to queue backlog (scale event id: se-9921).

eng_oncall: reproduced locally w/ long-context chat trace; when sequence len > 1024 and recent calib samples contained long tails, the runtime sometimes flips to a slower dequant kernel repeatedly. That explains tail spikes and streaming chunking.

tasha_sre: mitigation options:
- Option A: hot-rollback quant-profile to stable before the PR (stable-v1.9) — supported via hot-swap, should restore prior behavior quickly.
- Option B: force disable int8 quantization (fall back to fp16) for affected service — costlier but safe.
- Option C: increase KV cache size to reduce miss churn (longer-term).

sam_dev: prepared rollback command for option A: `redwoodctl model update redwood-int8-v2 --quant-profile=stable-v1.9 --hot-reload`

eng_oncall: executing rollback now. starting hot-swap to stable-v1.9 on 3 pods to canary. will watch p99 and streaming gaps.

deploy_bot: deploy action initiated by eng_oncall at 2026-03-14T03:18:21Z — rolling update: canary pods 1/3 updated. logs: deploy-id d-7745.

maria: enable streaming debug for canary pods: set ENV STREAM_DEBUG=1 and capture traces.

eng_oncall: canary updated, observing metrics... p99 for canary ~2.0s within 30s, chunk gap reduced to ~300-400ms. scaling roll to remaining pods.

deploy_bot: rolling update progressed: 3/3 pods on stable-v1.9 at 2026-03-14T03:22:05Z.

ops_bot: autoscaler back to baseline; queue drained.

eng_oncall: post-rollback observations: p95 ~1.1-1.4s, p99 ~2.0-2.3s; streaming stalls largely resolved. marking immediate mitigation successful.

sam_dev: preliminary root cause hypothesis: the new calibration smoothing interacted poorly with int8 kernel selection under long-context workloads. When calibration underestimated certain activation ranges, runtime triggered a dequant fallback that uses a slower execution path and causes repeated cache churn, amplifying tail latency.

tasha_sre: I filed INC-4872 and added timeline, logs, deploy ids, and perf dashboards. Also flagged alerts: lower threshold for streaming chunk-gap and add an alarm for repeated dequant fallbacks.

jamie_cs: informed Acme Retail that a rollback was completed and we expect normal behavior; offered a postmortem and ask to report any residuals. They asked for ETA on fix — told them we'll follow up after deeper investigation.

eng_oncall: handing off to oncall2 for follow-up and postmortem ownership. I'm closing the active pager. Thanks team.

oncall2: taking follow-up. i'll validate canary traces and schedule a calibration roll-forward with more conservative thresholds + a repro test.

maria: owners: sam_dev (root cause reproducer & fix), tasha_sre (alerts & runbook updates), oncall2 (validation & release plan).

ops_bot: pager closed by eng_oncall at 2026-03-14T03:28:09Z. incident state -> mitigated.

maria: action items assigned. we'll run a targeted load test (long-context chat mix) before any future calib changes. postmortem to follow in #postmortems.
